title: Set the default workflow user
when: The step asks to set or change the Default Workflow User on the Process Automation Settings page: the user that automation runs as when the triggering user is inactive. It is not activating a flow and not assigning a permission.
steps: In the embedded Process Automation Settings page, type the user's full name into the 'Default Workflow User' field, replacing what is there.
Click Save. This page has no read-only view: it is always an editable form, and Save returns the browser to Setup Home. That is expected, not an error.
Open Process Automation Settings again to see the saved value.
doneWhen: After saving and opening Process Automation Settings again, the Default Workflow User field holds the requested user.

verified.outcome: Trial step matched at p=1.00; 3 actions, 19 s, reviewer confirmed, held in a fresh session. Confirmed without any model: the Setup Audit Trail recorded 'Changed Default Workflow User from User User to Integration User'. Jev, shown that trail, gave p=0.98 for this step and p=0.03 for the same step naming a different user.

trial.step: Set the default workflow user to Integration User.

notes: The trial sets it to Integration User so the change is a real one. Saving this page also writes two unrelated audit entries every time (flowMetricsManageFlowOnlyOff, changedOrgWideEmailAddress), whether or not those settings changed.
